extract_batch over URI inputs

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [{"kind": "uri", "uri": "pdf/fake_memo.pdf"}, {"kind": "uri", "uri": "text/fake_text.txt"}]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    for result in result.results:
        print(result.content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
